description: Flow guard: enforces phase policy while a Flow phase runs (GD-001).

hooks.command: if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard.mjs" --session-start; elif [ -d "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/flow" ]; then printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage":"Flow: node not found in PATH, so the Flow guard is OFF (phase rules are not enforced). Install Node.js 18+ (https://nodejs.org) and restart Claude Code."}'; fi
